A '''male Jedi Knight''' was the first [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Soon after achieving knighthood, [[Gender/Legends|he]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by a vicious killer.

==Biography==
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] at an early age, he [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] throughout his childhood, before being accepted as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Unlike most Padawan-Master pairs, he and Ti did not accept journey missions from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]; instead Ti chose to train the boy in the wilds of [[Shili/Legends|Shili]]. Studying the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and how to survive in the wilderness, Ti's training methods emphasized training over experience.<ref name="NEGTC" />

When it was deemed that this Padawan had completed his training, the young Padawan faced his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] back on Coruscant and passed, ascending to the rank of Knight. Accepting missions from the High Council, the Knight was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] on one of his first assignments by a vicious killer.<ref name="NEGTC" />

==Legacy==
The death of her former apprentice gave Shaak Ti the unpleasant distinction of having trained two Padawans who met a violent death after becoming a Knight, the second being the late [[Fe Sun]]. Though she was overcome by grief, Ti was able to continue, using her strength to stay strong and true to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="NEGTC" />
